what: An L drawn with the line tool on the front plane XZ through (0, 0), (60, 0), (60, 6), (6, 6), (6, 40), (0, 40), extruded 30 (the starting box deleted first).

volume.why: the L as a 60 × 6 foot and a 6 × 34 upright on it, 564 mm², swept 30

area.why: two L caps and six sides: the outline's lengths 60, 6, 54, 34, 6, 40 (200 round), each 30 deep

topology.why: 6 sides and 2 caps; 6 edges round each cap and 6 along; 6 corners on each cap (12 − 18 + 8 = 2)

box.why: XZ's sketch x is X and y is Z; its normal is X × Z = −Y, so the extrude runs from y = 0 to −30

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm): a model we make ourselves has no entity looser than the kernel's own tolerance
